text:
Rina (Design): dropped a new compact-diff mock for prompt-sets in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/compact-diffs. Idea: single-column rows with a tiny left diff-bar, inline actions, and expandable details. aiming for fast scanning.
Noah (PM): looks good. how will bulk approve look? need explicit count + clear QA copy.
Rina (Design): sticky top toolbar shows count when selection>0 and buttons: "Accept selected runs" and "Reject selected runs". confirmation modal has explanation + hint about undo in activity history.
Kai (Frontend): implementation notes: virtualized list (react-window) with variable heights. rows are buttons for expand; icon actions must stopPropagation. keyboard: Enter toggles expand, Space toggles selection.
Zoe (A11y): a11y requirements: row use <button> with aria-expanded, action icons real <button>s with aria-labels, diff-bar needs text alternatives (aria-label like "quality decreased by 4%"). contrast: amber severity chip fails at small size.
Arun (UX Research): user tests prefer neutral language. avoid "regressed". tried "degraded quality" and "quality change" — latter is least alarming. also users liked inline accept + undo toast (10s).
ci-bot: CI results for branch feat/compact-diffs: 
```
axe: color-contrast (SeverityChip)  contrast 2.0:1 against white
eslint: jsx-a11y/no-noninteractive-element-interactions in RowSummary
```
Rina (Design): will update chip color and change RowSummary to a <button>. copy: switching label to "quality change". will add Undo spec and SR text for toasts.
Kai (Frontend): I'll address the lint/axe issues, add focus-visible rings, and post a 15s keyboard-nav demo on the PR.
Zoe (A11y): thanks — please add role="status" for non-critical toasts and ensure Undo action is tabbable.
Noah (PM): great, ship prototype to internal reviewers next week. leaving thread open for any more copy/a11y followups. :sparkles:
